events.context: User decides to modify LaTeX document for double-blind review: '我还是让它在latex里改成双盲吧。怎么改？'
System provides steps to modify main.tex for double-blind: comment out or delete author block
Modify LaTeX author section: comment out \author{ Lucia Yizi Zhang... Dr. Peng Zhao... }
Optionally add \author{ANONYMIZED FOR REVIEW} before \maketitle in main.tex
Search for identity-revealing terms in main.tex: 'Zhang', 'Zhao', 'our', 'we have previously argued'; replace with anonymized versions like 'Author'
Remove acknowledgments section from main.tex, move to Title Page
Create new titlepage.tex with full author info, title, acknowledgments, funding, competing interests, author contributions
Handle self-citations in references.bib: keep as is for published works, avoid explanatory text like 'as we have shown'
Compile anonymous main.tex: pdflatex main.tex; bibtex main; pdflatex main.tex (twice); verify no author info, no self-references, page numbers enabled
Prepare files for Editorial Manager: main.pdf (anonymous), titlepage.pdf/docx, source files (main.tex, references.bib)
